definitions.core_principle: Counting own/exalted planets does not make a chart strong. Check the star lord of each dignified planet, the dasa+bhukti pairing, lords 3/5 (courage, intellect) for business ability, and where the yoga 'diverts' its result.
definitions.duplicate_dignity: An own/exalted planet whose star lord is weak (in 6/8/12, inimical, debilitated) is 'duplicate' dignity - it may still shake the job but won't deliver business success.
definitions.rule_break_points: Every rule has a breaking point (e.g. retro+node = good unless the dispositor is afflicted); keep fine-tuning.
definitions.dasa_gate: All results only in the relevant dasa/bhukti.

rules.name: Own-sign dasa lord + own-sign bhukti lord
rules.condition: both dasa lord and bhukti lord own/exalted (any houses)
rules.result: Job oscillation/pressure during that bhukti (merger, cost cuts, pushed out). Business owners tend to over-invest (raw material, stock, machinery) and fall into debt.
rules.outcome: ~80% end up better after the push; ~20% exceptions.

rules.name: Own-sign 10th lord does not guarantee business
rules.condition: lord_10 own sign but its star lord is weak (e.g. Moon own in 10th in Saturn's star, Saturn in 12th)
rules.result: Talent and job eminence, but cannot start/sustain own business; career stress in that bhukti; eases in the following bhuktis.
rules.example_flow: Thula lagna: Venus dasa (Venus own in lagna, in Rahu's star; Rahu in 10th) + Moon bhukti (Moon own in 10th, Pushya) -> high stress; Mars bhukti softer, Rahu softer, Jupiter bhukti (lord_6 in 12) -> fully satisfying job.

rules.name: Business courage test
conditions_for_business: lord_3 not in 12 (lord_3 in 12 gives courage to handle big jobs, not to stand on own finances)
lord_2 (finance) not debilitated-then-neecha-bhanga (that pattern = earns by working, not by owning)
Sun+Saturn trade yoga only works in kendra/trikona/11, not in 12
rules.result: If these fail, advise job; 'middle-class trap' - can't move up into business, job keeps getting disturbed.

rules.name: Job vs business balance (lord_6 vs lord_10)

branches.if: lord_10 strong, lord_6 weak, a dasa hits the 6th
lord_6 strong, lord_10 weak, started business

rules.name: Node with own-sign planet - same star check

branches.if: Rahu/Ketu with own-sign planet, different nakshatra padas

rules.note: Rahu and Ketu act the same way as boosters; whether their own dasa gives or takes is judged separately via deciding authorities.

rules.name: Rahu dasa via deciding authorities in 3/11
rules.condition: Rahu's sign lord and star lord 3/11 from each other
rules.result: Rahu dasa yogic (e.g. Rahu in 10th with own-sign 10th lord = career win).

rules.name: Yoga diversion
rules.result: A strong placement may deliver its benefit to a different area than expected, e.g. strong Jupiter but no children, Don't promise the 'main road' result.

rules.name: Two marriages via 2/7 lord (Mars for Thula)

branches.if: Mars debilitated with neecha-bhanga (esp. with Rahu)

rules.name: Children: lord_5 + Jupiter in 6/8/12
rules.result: No children in the first marriage; check the 5th from the 11th (second spouse) for children later.

rules.name: Afflicted 5th lord dasa
rules.condition: lord_5 dasa/bhukti/antara or star touched, lord_5 retrograde/debilitated/with malefic

branches_by_age.result: Character tested; zeal in a newly adopted belief

rules.neutraliser: Jupiter / lagna lord / lord_5 link -> only inner turbulence

rules.name: Planets conjoined with dignified / debilitated planets

branches.then: Mild internal changes only; good overall
Business fails; employment OK though native grumbles

branches.if: Saturn retrograde in exchange with Mercury, Rahu with Mercury
branches.then: Saturn and Rahu dasas yogic; Mercury dasa also good

rules.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati yoga quality by lagna
rules.result: Stronger for Kanni (Mercury lagna lord + Venus) than Mesha (Jupiter + Saturn, Saturn being badhaka). Rishabha: Saturn own sign as 9+10 lord still fails for business if dispositor and star lord are 2/12 from each other.

branches.then: Not a character flaw by itself

branches.if: Venus alone in Mesha/Vrischika lagna with malefic aspect/conjunction, dasa in youth

rules.name: Lone retrograde Mercury
rules.result: Blind courage - acts against all advice.

rules.name: Derived houses for parents
rules.example: Mithuna lagna, Saturn own in 9th: for father, Saturn is his 12th lord own sign -> father buys property/vehicles (even on loan) in Saturn dasa; for mother (4th = Kanni), Saturn own in her 6th -> job change for mother.

points: Saturn in udayam, arudam in 12th from udayam, or arudam lord in kavippu -> delay
Time units by kavippu: 15 days / 1.5 months / 1.5 years (or day/week/month/year) - pick what fits the question
Udayam and arudam together with Moon on them -> immediate success
Change question -> treat previous arudam as new udayam
